stepTitle: The leftmost gear (pink, $$14$$ teeth) meshes with the larger gear (blue, $$42$$ teeth) of the central compound pair. As the pink gear completes one clockwise rotation, how many times does the blue gear rotate counterclockwise? (Enter your answer as a simplified fraction).
choices: $$\frac{a}{b}=\frac{c}{d}$$ if and only if $$ad=bc$$, and $$b$$ and $$d$$ are nonzero
